product: VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 - VCF Automation (successor to vRealize Automation / Aria Automation)
api_reference_title: Provider Infrastructure APIs (VCF Automation OpenAPI / Provider Management)

no_published_specification.statement: VCF Automation has no specification document in VMware's Apache-2.0 vmware/vcf-api-specs repository, so no specification path or commit SHA could be pinned for this task. docs/contract.json was therefore transcribed by hand from the rendered Broadcom xAPIs reference pages listed below.

pages.title: Provider Management (Getting Started)
pages.documents: API-wide conventions: JWT in the Authorization header, X-VMWARE-VCLOUD-TENANT-CONTEXT / X-VMWARE-VCLOUD-AUTH-CONTEXT headers, the CRUD response-code pattern, asynchronous operations answering 202 with an empty body and a tracking task URI in the Location header, error conditions, URN identifiers, filtering and sorting on list endpoints, and the requirement that the accept header carry the API version (for example application/json;version=9.1.0).

pages.title: Query Virtual Centers
pages.documents: GET /cloudapi/1.0.0/virtualCenters. Query parameters filter (optional, FIQL format), sortAsc (optional), sortDesc (optional), page (required, minimum 1, default 1) and pageSize (required, minimum 0, maximum 128, default 25). Response 200 returns VCenterServers as application/json;version=9.1.0.

pages.title: Attach Virtual Center
pages.documents: POST /cloudapi/1.0.0/virtualCenters. Request body VCenterServer as application/json. Responses: 202 (request accepted, the task that monitors the request is in the Location header, no data structure returned), 400 Invalid configuration returning Error, 401 Unauthorized with no data structure, 404 returning Error. Availability: added in 34.0.

pages.title: VCenterServer (data structure)
pages.documents: Field-by-field definition of the vCenter server object: name, username and url are Required; vcId, description, password, isEnabled, vsphereWebClientServerUrl, hasProxy, rootFolder, vcNoneNetwork, vcNoneNetworkMoref, tenantVisibleName, isConnected, mode, listenerState, clusterHealthStatus, vcVersion, buildNumber, uuid, nsxVManager, proxyConfigurationUrn, isDedicatedForClassicTenants, licenseStatus and sddcManager are Optional. Property order in this contract follows the declaration order on this page.

pages.title: VCenterServers (data structure)
pages.documents: The list envelope returned by Query Virtual Centers: allOf Page plus a values array of VCenterServer.

pages.title: Page (data structure)
pages.documents: Paging metadata composed into list responses: resultTotal, pageCount, page (1-indexed), pageSize and associations, all Optional.

pages.title: Error (data structure)
pages.documents: The error payload returned by Attach Virtual Center and other operations: minorErrorCode (Required), message (Required), stackTrace (Optional).

pages.title: REST API Index (operation index)
pages.documents: The full operation listing for the reference, used to confirm the exact paths of the two Virtual Center operations in this contract and to confirm that this reference publishes no task-polling operation and no idempotency-key mechanism.
